name: CommunityCallouts - What Happens Here
description: The block that lets a community page read as finished before it has any events. The AI community's main activity is an open call every other week, as schedules allow, and a recurring call is not a calendar entry, so the page previously carried only a blurb and a photo and a visitor could not tell whether anything was happening. The third card deliberately has no detail line, proving the optional text is genuinely optional and a card without it still sits flush with its neighbours.
